'''Jedi Pack''' is the 9th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in April 1996.<ref name="enc32jp">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=33 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 33 (Promotional Packs). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

It is a free promotional pack of 11 cards (5 Light Side, 5 Dark Side, plus the Hyperoute Navigation Chart game aid) with a promotional booklet.<ref name="enc32jp" /><ref name="enc20">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=24 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], p. 24 (Promotional Cards) and pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Distribution ==
The sealed bag is printed "FREE JEDI PACK" and "ONE PER CUSTOMER... PLEASE".

Decipher handed the pack out at employee promotional appearances and mailed it on request.<ref name="enc20" />

''[[Scrye]]'' #18 (February 1997) packed one as a magazine insert.<ref name="enc20" /><ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The [[First Anthology]] box also included one.<ref name="enc20" /><ref name="enc32fa">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=26 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 26 (First Anthology). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
